title: Not a baby / What's the time? I must ... at ...
subtitle: 不是小孩子了 / 几点了？我必须在……点……

lead.question: 十八岁的吉尔晚上要去找朋友，父亲说「必须早点回家、十一点一刻后不许回」——怎样用 be going to 说计划，用 must/mustn't 定规矩，用 enjoy yourself 祝她玩得开心？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。吉尔十八岁了，今晚打算去见朋友。父亲立规矩：必须早点回家，不能在十一点一刻之后回；同时把前门的钥匙给她——「你不是小孩子了」。听录音时抓住 be going to（打算）、must be home at half past ten（必须十点半前到家）、mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven（禁止晚归），以及 enjoy yourself 这类反身代词用法。
goals: 能用 What are you going to do ...? 询问并表达将来计划（be going to）
能用 must + 动词原形 与 mustn't 定规矩（must be home / mustn't come home late）
掌握钥匙表达 the key to the front door 与递物 Here you are
理解反身代词 yourself / ourselves，enjoy oneself 表示「过得愉快」
读懂时间表达 half past ten / a quarter past eleven
lead.summary: 第 65 课父亲问吉尔今晚打算做什么，听说她要去见朋友，便要求她早点回家、不可在十一点一刻后回，并因为「她十八岁了，不是小孩子」把前门钥匙给了她。全课用 be going to 表计划、用 must/mustn't 定家规。第 66 课用主语 + must + 动词短语 + at + 时刻 操练时间安排。
lead.tips: ① be going to + 动原 表已定的将来计划；② You must be home at half past ten 中 be home 指「到家/在家」；③ mustn't 禁止，a quarter past eleven = 11:15；④ key to the front door 钥匙「开」某物用 to；⑤ enjoy oneself 过得愉快，yourself/ourselves 是反身代词；⑥ Here you are 递东西。

questions.q: Can Jill have the key to the front door?
questions.zh: 吉尔能拿到前门的钥匙吗？
questions.a: Yes, she can. Her father gives it to her because she is eighteen, not a baby.
questions.aZh: 能。父亲给她是因为她十八岁了，不是小孩。
questions.hint: 听 Jill is eighteen years old, she is not a baby. Give her the key to the front door.

questions.q: What is Jill going to do this evening?
questions.a: She's going to meet some friends.

questions.zh: 吉尔必须在几点前到家？
questions.a: At half past ten; she mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.
questions.aZh: 十点半前；不能在十一点一刻之后回家。

questions.q: How does Jill's father describe her?
questions.zh: 吉尔的父亲怎么形容她？
questions.a: She is eighteen years old and not a baby.
questions.aZh: 她十八岁了，不是小孩子。

questions.q: Why does the father say 'she is not a baby'?
questions.zh: 为什么父亲说「她不是小孩子了」？
questions.a: To show she is grown up enough to have her own key and come home on her own; 'baby' here means a small child who still needs looking after.
questions.aZh: 说明她已长大，够格拿自己的钥匙、自己回家；baby 这里指需要照顾的小孩。
questions.hint: not a baby = 长大了、独立了。

questions.q: She must go to the library at 1.15. / I must type this letter at 2.00.
questions.zh: 第 66 课操练：把 主语 + must + 动词短语 + at + 时刻 成对替换。
questions.a: Sam and Penny must see the boss at 1.30.
questions.aZh: 萨姆和彭妮必须在 1 点 30 分见老板。
questions.hint: must + 动词原形 + at + 时刻。

grammar.title: be going to 表示将来计划
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: be going to 结构表示已经决定或计划好的将来行为，强调主观打算，比一般现在时表示的将来更明确。
grammar.usage: What are you going to do this evening? / I'm going to meet some friends.

examples.en: What are you going to do this evening, Jill?
examples.zh: 吉尔，今晚你打算做什么？

examples.en: I'm going to meet some friends, Dad.
examples.zh: 我打算去见几个朋友，爸爸。

grammar.title: must / mustn't 表示义务与禁止（复现）
grammar.structure: 主语 + must/mustn't + 动词原形
grammar.definition: must 表示必须、应当（定规矩）；mustn't 表示禁止、不允许。用于家长对孩子的要求等。
grammar.usage: You must come home early. / You mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.

examples.en: You must come home early.
You mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.
examples.zh: 你不可以在十一点一刻之后回家。

grammar.title: 反身代词与 enjoy oneself；key to ...
grammar.structure: 反身代词 myself/yourself/ourselves ... ；enjoy oneself；the key to + 名词
grammar.definition: 反身代词 oneself 随主语变化（I→myself, you→yourself, we→ourselves）。enjoy oneself 表示「过得愉快、玩得开心」。key 表示「……的钥匙」用 to 连接。
grammar.usage: I always enjoy myself. / the key to the front door

examples.en: I always enjoy myself.
the key to the front door
